target.title: fix(exa): cover centralized web search secrets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Exa web search already relies on the centralized runtime web-search SecretRef resolver, but the regression coverage did not lock that contract for Exa specifically. That made it easy for future Exa changes to reintroduce provider-local SecretRef handling or silently bypass configured SecretRefs with `EXA_API_KEY` fallback.

## Why This Change Was Made
This PR adds focused regression coverage for the existing centralized Exa credential path instead of changing Exa runtime behavior. The tests prove Exa participates in the shared web-search SecretRef matrix and that the runtime diagnostics/recovery path stays explicit when a configured Exa SecretRef is unresolved.

## User Impact
Users who configure an Exa web-search SecretRef get coverage that the runtime resolves the configured credential through the shared path. If the configured Exa SecretRef cannot be resolved, the diagnostic/recovery behavior is covered without silently changing provider routing.

## Evidence
- `extensions/exa/src/exa-web-search-provider.test.ts` covers configured Exa API key precedence over ambient `EXA_API_KEY` and the documented `EXA_API_KEY` fallback when no key is configured.
- `src/secrets/runtime-web-tools.test.ts` includes Exa in the shared web-search provider SecretRef matrix.
- `src/secrets/runtime-web-tools.test.ts` covers unresolved Exa SecretRefs plus `EXA_API_KEY` recovery diagnostics.
- Net production behavior is unchanged; `extensions/exa/src/exa-web-search-provider.runtime.ts` still only consumes an already-resolved configured key or `EXA_API_KEY` fallback.

## Proof
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=.vitest-cache-exa-secretref PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/workSpace/claw-campaign-llagy/openclaw/node_modules node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/exa/src/exa-web-search-provider.test.ts src/secrets/runtime-web-tools.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose` (46 runtime web-tools tests + 18 Exa provider tests passed)
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/exa/src/exa-web-search-provider.runtime.ts extensions/exa/src/exa-web-search-provider.test.ts src/secrets/runtime-web-tools.ts src/secrets/runtime-web-tools.test.ts`
- `PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/workSpace/claw-campaign-llagy/openclaw/node_modules node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/exa/src/exa-web-search-provider.runtime.ts extensions/exa/src/exa-web-search-provider.test.ts src/secrets/runtime-web-tools.ts src/secrets/runtime-web-tools.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- No live Exa API request was run; this is a secretless runtime/config matrix proof and does not require a live provider key.
